productNotes.GTTA: This is the annual leg of the Paris Agreement Forecast Contracts, which the exchange lists as Annual Global Temperature Threshold. It asks whether any year breaches a target on or before an end date.
productNotes.GTTM: This is the monthly leg of the Paris Agreement Forecast Contracts, which the exchange lists as Monthly Global Temperature Threshold. It asks whether any month breaches a target on or before an end date.
productNotes.RT: This contract asks whether the year ranks warmest since 1850, not whether it passes a level. Year-to-year swings around the warming trend are driven substantially by El Nino and La Nina, so a record is far more likely in some years than the trend alone suggests.
productNotes.MRT: This contract asks whether the month ranks warmest on record, not whether it passes a level. Month-to-month swings around the warming trend are driven substantially by El Nino and La Nina.
productNotes.GT: The value is an anomaly against the twentieth-century average, not an absolute temperature.
productNotes.UST: This is an absolute average temperature rather than an anomaly, so it is not comparable with the global temperature contracts on this site.
